facts.business: Vas Infrastructure Ltd is an Indian listed company currently undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Canara Bank classified the loan account as fraud on 17th February 2026, later quashed by High Court on 31/07/2026; Resolution Professional filed PUFE application reporting fraudulent transactions aggregating INR 261.09 Crores

key_risks: PUFE application filed for INR 261.09 Cr fraudulent transactions
Board powers suspended, dependent on CIRP outcome
Future prospects dependent on success of CIRP process
facts.related_party_note: Company does not have any Holding or Subsidiary Company; no commission/remuneration from group companies
